body:
Small drift between docs, server and UI wording around expenses:

- docs/wire-contract.md says only that both share maps are non-empty; the server also caps each map at EXPENSE_SHARES_MAX = 200 participants (sync.py:114) with 422 invalid_expense. Document it.
- UI strings on both clients say an expenses list's currency is "fixed once the list exists" / "keeps its type and its currency for life" (overview.currencyHelp, listProps.kindFixed). The server only forbids blanking it (wire contract: "can never be blanked there"); a non-blank change is accepted, and the list-properties screens simply do not offer one. Decide: either the server refuses changing it (then say so in the contract, like the kind) or the wording says the clients do not offer it. Maintainer call.
- The error table lists invalid_currency once for two rules; that is its own ticket.
title: Docs/wording drift: undocumented 200-participant cap; currency 'fixed for life' vs server that only forbids blanking
